thread:
mira: Heads-up: prototype for Delegated Approvals in the evals UI is in Figma. Goal: let team leads assign approval responsibility for subsets (by prompt-set/tag) and capture an audit trail + optional PII redaction before export. Looking for UX, copy, and a11y feedback.
sam: I like the use-case. One ask: how do we show which reviewer is responsible inline? We can't add a big column. Maybe a compact avatar+role chip per run row.
olivia: agree on avatar chip. Copy nit: the chip label should read 'Reviewer: Ana' rather than just a name to reduce ambiguity. For smaller widths show just initials with tooltip.
kevin: implementation note: assigning via a flyout from the row's kebab menu feels low friction. Make assignment modal keyboard-trappable. Example aria: `div[role="dialog"][aria-labelledby="assign-heading"]`.
carmen: for delegated ranges, allow rules like "approve only if score >= X" or "require manual review if delta > Y". This saves reviewers time.
mira: good idea @carmen. We'll surface a simple rule UI: threshold slider + toggle for 'Require manual review on large regressions'. Keep defaults conservative.
a11y-bot: accessibility flags: the threshold slider must expose current value via `aria-valuenow` and have a textual label. Also the assignment flyout needs clear focus order and close on Esc.
olivia: microcopy: for the export and audit CSV header, include columns: reviewer, assigned_by, assigned_at, action, reason, redacted_fields. For redaction copy: 'Remove PII before export' with a clear preview.
sam: UX question: redaction should be optional per export or enforced by org policy? We need both. Suggest an org-level toggle (admin) + per-export override.
mira: yes — plan: org policy setting in Admin (enforced), but export UI shows a redaction checkbox with tooltip when allowed to override. If enforced, checkbox disabled with explanation text.
kevin: small implementation guard: redaction is async (we call redact service). The export button should show a spinner and disable while redaction runs. Announce progress to SRs: `aria-live="polite"` region with 'Redaction in progress'.
a11y-bot: also ensure exports have skip-links for keyboard users to get to the 'Include full examples' toggle, since that area will be low on the page.
carmen: about audit trail: we should allow reviewers to bulk-add a reason template (like tags: 'model-regression', 'acceptable-variance', 'formatting-issue') to speed up approvals. Also allow a short free-text note.
olivia: good. For tagging UI use accessible multiselect with clear sr-only instructions: 'Type to add tags or pick from suggestions'.
sam: permissions: need an explicit state for 'delegated reviewer pending acceptance' so the assignee can accept or decline. Show pending badge on rows and send an in-app notif.
mira: noted. We'll add an acceptance step: email + in-app prompt that includes a one-click accept/decline. Pending rows are locked for other reviewers until accepted.
kevin: keyboard behavior: when a reviewer accepts, move focus to the first locked row so they can start reviewing immediately. Also add a 'snooze' option on the assignment notif.
a11y-bot: nit: avoid using 'lock' icon alone. Combine with text 'Awaiting acceptance' and include sr-only context 'This item is assigned to you and locked until accepted.'
carmen: export preview: show a small sample (3 rows) with redaction toggled on/off so admins can verify before downloading. Also show estimated size.
olivia: copy for the admin tooltip: 'Redaction removes user-identifying data from examples; it may alter sample content slightly.' Keep the tone neutral.
sam: QA concern: we need tests for concurrent assignment conflicts (two leads assigning same set) and for redaction edge-cases (special characters, non-UTF-8).
qa-bot: Test tasks created: delegated-assignment-flow, export-redaction-preview, assignment-accept-decline, concurrent-assignment-conflict. Scheduling for next CI.
mira: action items summary: 1) add reviewer chip (Reviewer: Name) compact with tooltip 2) assignment flyout + acceptance flow + pending state 3) rules UI: threshold slider + toggle for large regressions 4) export UI: redaction checkbox w/ preview and admin policy enforcement 5) audit CSV headers and sample preview 6) keyboard/a11y polish per a11y-bot suggestions 7) bulk tag templates for reasons.
kevin: I'll prototype the flyout HTML structure and aria attributes, and add unit tests for focus management and aria-live announcements. ETA: 2 days.
olivia: I'll draft microcopy for the flyout, export tooltip, and the pending-state text and post variants here for a quick content ops vote.
mira: thanks everyone. I'll update the Figma frames with reviewer chips, pending badges, and export preview. Linking PR + QA tasks once ready. :white_check_mark:
